vision.name: Buu's Absorbing Drill
vision.text:
(Limit 1 per deck. This card is not discarded when advancing a level. Use only if your opponent has not performed a successful attack this combat.)
[Defense] POWER: Stops a physical or energy attack.
You may discard a card from your hand to perform a copy of that attack for your next action.
vision.note: landscape Drill layout; grey card; no Endurance badge
